Build a voice from its body, then have it sing, beatbox or play in a band, right in your browser.

It still sounds synthetic, and the lead sings "da" because words are harder but let me improve it. Free and open source:

A lot of you asked whether Voice Workshop can sing and beatbox. It can now.

Here's an 80s-style action theme by five vocal tracts that don't exist. Nothing is recorded: each mouth is a physics model of throat, tongue and lips, and the colours are the air going through it. https://t.co/6wMdiGFMk0 https://t.co/DuXCjsypA3

data.text:
6/ What's next? I'm building something with the library itself. I can't say what yet, still experimenting, but these voices are about to leave the lab 👀

Free and open source (Apache-2.0).
Try it: https://t.co/TLnJ0fDWu4
Code: https://t.co/big6ysyIqM

5/ The limits, honestly: it still sounds synthetic, not like a person. A learnt voice is of the same kind as its speaker, not a copy. Learnt rhythm and melody exist only for Italian so far; other languages follow rules, and some consonants are still unclear.

4/ The voices also work without the interface: a small JS library for Node and the browser.

Make a voice from its knobs, have it say text or phonemes with an emotion, write dialogues between voices, find a voice from a few recordings, export a WAV.

3/ Two voices learnt from recordings of an Italian woman and man: body and folds fitted to them, sounds tuned against a speech recogniser, rhythm and melody from a small neural net.

Work in progress: I'm testing prosody and voice training, and I'll write up the whole process.

2/ It now speaks about 70 languages (it was English and Italian), or any IPA.

Every IPA symbol comes from articulatory rules: tones, clicks, ejectives, implosives, real trills (yes, the Czech ř), creak, falsetto, whisper. Deeper physics too: folds, trachea, twang.

Voice Workshop now has a proper Voices section 🎙️

Start from 17 voices or a recording, or build one from the body up: tract, palate, tongue, lips, vocal folds, habits, melody. Hear it speak, save it, share it as a link.

All physics, computed live in your browser. What's new 🧵 https://t.co/JZjqGrejf2
